facts.text: Policlinico Casilino began as Villa Irma, a nursing home founded in 1967 by the Pio Istituto di Santo Spirito e Ospedali Riuniti.
In 1971 the clinic moved to Via Casilina in Torre Spaccata, expanding to 250 beds for medicine, surgery, and obstetrics.
Between the 1970s and 1980s the facility grew into a full hospital, adding cardiology, intensive cardiac care, plastic surgery, and ophthalmology.
A new 3,000‑square‑meter emergency room opened in 2016, modernizing the hospital’s urgent‑care services.
The complex spans five buildings labeled A through E, plus an emergency room, day‑surgery building, and clinic, all within a large parking lot and small park.
Policlinico Casilino is owned by the Eurosanità group, founded by Tullio Ciarrapico, who acquired the hospital in 1995.
